_notes: Hand-kept. Maps a Sova model ref (provider/id as the session records it) onto a models.dev key (provider/model). Read by shared/model-prices/prices.ts.
providers: <provider>/<id> -> <to>/<id> when models.dev prices that key (a trailing -YYYYMMDD is tried without it; a trailing [1m] is always dropped). local: $0.

models: explicit refs, checked before the provider rule. '*/<id>' matches any provider. A list is dated: the first entry whose 'until' is after the message (or has none) wins. A recorded responseModel beats these.
unpriced: tokens count, no dollars, never a sibling's price. free: $0 by nature.
derive: rates models.dev doesn't list, as a multiple of input. Anthropic bills a 1-hour cache write at 2x input (docs.claude.com pricing); models.dev's cache_write is the 5-minute rate.
